subject: [hw] T01: 2 small class bugs left for acceptance (V16 LDM base-in-list, V17/V15 k_fvec_loop); can you restart owners?
body:
T01s run_diff is 19290/19320 with V14+V19 patches in tree. Remaining:
1) V16 n2a32_t32_mem.c LDM with base in list adds the writeback amount to the loaded base: `ldm r7,{r2,r3,r7}` memory [11111111,22222222,aaaaaaaa] gives r7=aaaaaab6 (should aaaaaaaa). Small repro posted to R1. This is a real V16 bug, not just the atomic kernel.
2) k_v15_extend 5 seeds (arm-O2/thumb-O2; CLZ 14 vs 6) and k_fvec_loop thumb-O3v 20 seeds (scalar VFP loop; float math correct in trace, suspect store/load addressing). Owners V15/V17 are finished/error; R1 has the dumps but no fix yet.
Can you restart V16/V17 or authorize R1/me to patch? I already applied R1s V14 and my V19 patches (announced). No phone work needed.
